temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Page 4: Mosquitoes collected and characterized in 'July 2015, September 2016 and October 2017' (3-year window 2015–2017).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper reports original local field collections and monitoring from Opeibea, Accra, Ghana.

supplement.evidence: Main text and figures provide total genotyped sample size (N=171), species identification, and average/yearly allele frequencies for Vgsc-1014F and ace-1.

assessment.summary: This study monitored insecticide resistance intensity and target-site mutations (Vgsc-L1014F and Ace-1 G119S) in Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) collected from Opeibea, Accra, Ghana between 2015 and 2017. A total of 171 mosquitoes (169 An. gambiae s.s. and 2 An. coluzzii) were genotyped, showing average allele frequencies of 0.99 for Vgsc-1014F and 0.76 for Ace-1 G119S.
